title: Sivia: Learning to Draw, Learning to Learn
abstract: arXiv:2609.33386v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A paper's overview figure is often the first thing readers see: it must explain the method correctly and look polished. We present Sivia, an overview-figure system that reads the paper, plans its relations, adapts visual organization from recent top-conference papers, and composes a design for image generation. Sivia improves with use through human-guided recursive self-improvement (RSI) at two levels: learning to draw revises its drawing skill from feedback on accuracy and presentation, and learning to learn revises the updater that proposes those revisions. A personal profile adapts presentation to its user's aesthetic preferences while the scientific content stays fixed. A diagnostic study of 1,964 overviews for 445 papers (17,973 relation judgments) shows that most errors are omissions and that source-derived relation plans raise required-relation accuracy (RRA) by up to 19.85 points. translated_abstract: 论文的概览图往往是读者最先看到的内容：它必须正确地解释方法，并且外观精致。我们提出了Sivia，一个概览图系统，它能够阅读论文、规划其中的关系、借鉴近期顶级会议论文的视觉组织方式，并组合出一个用于图像生成的设计方案。Sivia通过人类引导的递归自我改进（RSI）在使用中不断提升，分为两个层次：“学会绘图”根据准确性和呈现方面的反馈来修正其绘图技能，“学会学习”则修正提出这些修正的更新器本身。个人配置文件可以在科学内容保持不变的前提下，让呈现方式适应用户的审美偏好。一项针对445篇论文的1,964张概览图的诊断研究（共17,973次关系判断）表明，大多数错误属于遗漏，而源自论文内容的关系规划可将必需关系准确率（RRA）提升多达19.85分。在48篇测试论文上，同时学习两个层次达到了（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: Sivia是一个能自动为论文生成精美概览图的系统，通过“学会绘图”与“学会学习”两层人类引导的递归自我改进不断提升绘图质量，其基于论文内容的关系规划可将必需关系准确率提升多达19.85分。
en_tdlr: Sivia is a system that automatically generates polished overview figures for academic papers, continuously improving through two-level human-guided recursive self-improvement ("learning to draw" and "learning to learn"), with source-derived relation plans boosting required-relation accuracy by up to 19.85 points.
